record: SPPPO V1 strategic payoff-preserving PPO permanent result freeze
classification_note: Valid treatment that completed the frozen scientific evaluation. NOT INVALID.
claim: Persistent assigned-pole latent training combined with payoff-aware strategic ranking did not achieve preregistered crossover confidence on the untouched 192-seed final block, despite strong retention and substantial behavioral separation.
closeout: SPPPO V1 completed a valid, prospectively controlled test of persistent assigned-pole latent training combined with payoff-aware strategic ranking. The resulting K=2 policy retained strong task performance and substantial behavioral separation, and both held-out payoff contrasts were correctly signed, but neither crossover effect achieved the preregistered confidence bound and Pole-B behavioral identity failed. SPPPO V1 is therefore NOT CONFIRMED. No rerun, lambda-grid extension, seed expansion, estimator change, or post-hoc threshold modification is authorized.

interpretation_notes.title: Strategic direction present but not reliable
interpretation_notes.summary: Both payoff contrasts had the intended sign, but neither cleared the frozen confidence requirement.
interpretation_notes.permitted_claim: Correctly directed point estimates without statistically confirmed crossover under the preregistered 192-seed evaluation.

interpretation_notes.title: Performance was not the bottleneck
interpretation_notes.summary: Retention passed very strongly, ruling out the easy explanation that compression simply destroyed task competence.

interpretation_notes.title: Behavioral diversity was not sufficient
interpretation_notes.summary: JSD passed strongly and Pole-A identity passed, yet strategic crossover still failed. Pole-B identity failed with confidently wrong-signed margin.
interpretation_notes.central_result: Different latent behaviors, strong retained performance, and even explicit payoff-aware training are not sufficient to guarantee a reliably complementary latent strategic repertoire.

interpretation_notes.title: First clean negative against the treatment actually intended
interpretation_notes.summary: EXP2B/EXP2C cannot establish this conclusion because persistent assignment was not instantiated there. SPPPO V1 maintained z0<->A and z1<->B throughout training.

development_final_distinction.development_reason: Only grid point improving both contrasts relative to the corrected structural-zero control on the out-of-sample development block.
development_final_distinction.caveat: Development selection did not reproduce with sufficient confidence on the untouched final block. Boundary selection at the top of the lambda grid remains a caveat, not a reason to reopen tuning.

bootstrap.procedure: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level episode outcomes

branch_resolution.signature: crossover FAIL (both contrasts correctly signed at mean), retention PASS, identity FAIL (margin_B)
branch_resolution.SPPPO_V2: NOT AUTHORIZED without fresh prospective PI decision
